body.raw:
# Project overview

Developed a bakery ordering application prototype using Next.js, TypeScript, and Supabase, with customer customization forms, authentication, admin order views, database migrations, and Stripe Checkout integration code.

## Current status

The project is paused before verified production delivery. The implementation includes frontend and backend code; deployment and end-to-end acceptance remain unverified.
